|quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Spirit Offering''' is an [[offering]] [[spell]] that consumes a [[corpse]], granting increased [[critical strike chance]] and additional [[critical strike multiplier]] to the player's [[minion]]s. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed. ==Skill functions and interactions== The skill consumes a corpse and up to 4 additional corpses around it. Each additional corpse extends the base [[duration]] of the skill by 1 second, making the maximum achievable base duration 9 seconds. Each player may only have one [[offering]] active at any time, unless equipping an item such as {{il|Leash of Oblation}}. Casting an offering skill while one is already active will cancel the older one. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Crit

This change affects existing items. }} {{Version history table row|3.10.0| * No longer grants a portion of the minion's maximum life as Energy Shield. * Now grants +20% to Chaos Resistance at gem level 1, up to +30% at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|3.8.0| * Now has a base duration of 5 seconds (from 3), with an additional 1 second per corpse consumed (from 0.5), up to a maximum of 4 corpses (from 8). * You now gain 4% Life as extra Energy Shield per corpse consumed (from 2%). * Now applies a visual effect above the player while it is active. }} {{Version history table row|2.3.0| * Spirit Offering has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}}
